decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.3%, S&P 500 -0.1%), a neutral session with no broad risk-on signal. Rather than forcing cash into mediocre setups, we deployed into CCI and NET, the only two candidates showing full four-signal confirmation (RSI, MACD, price vs SMA-20, and volume surge), leaving one slot and some cash in reserve.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially flat today, with the NASDAQ edging up slightly and the S&P 500 dipping marginally, reflecting a lack of strong directional catalysts. Without major earnings surprises or macro data surprises driving sentiment, trading stayed range-bound and institutional flows were selective rather than broad-based. This kind of quiet session often favors stock-pickers who can find individual names with genuine volume-backed momentum rather than chasing the index.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現平穩，納斯達克指數微升,標普500指數則略為下跌，反映市場缺乏明確的方向性催化劑。由於沒有重大盈利或宏觀數據意外，大盤維持窄幅波動,機構資金流向亦較為選擇性，而非全面流入。在這種淡靜的交易日,透過個股分析尋找具備成交量支持的真實動能標的,往往比盲目追蹤大盤指數更為有效。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Volume confirmation means a price move is backed by unusually high trading activity, suggesting real institutional buying rather than a random blip. When RSI, MACD, and price-above-moving-average signals all line up alongside a volume surge, it's a stronger signal than any single indicator alone.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 成交量確認是指價格變動伴隨異常高的交易量,顯示背後有真實的機構買盤,而非隨機波動。當RSI、MACD和價格高於移動平均線等訊號同時出現,並伴隨成交量激增時,這比單一指標更能確認趨勢的真實性。
